    recipient_org,
    payload || CHAR(10) || CHAR(10) || '| Full Name | Email | Role' || CHAR(10) || '|---|---|---' || CHAR(10) ||

    '=== PROTOCOL REVISIONS ===' ||
    CHAR(10) ||
    '=== All Protocol Revisions (chronological) ===' ||
    CHAR(10) ||

    '/ **' || author || ' | ' || date || '** Content: ' || content ||
    CASE WHEN notes IS NOT NULL THEN CHAR(10) || 'Notes: ' || notes ELSE '' END ||
    CHAR(10) as base_payload
  FROM protocol_revisions
)
SELECT recipient_org, payload FROM build_data UNION ALL SELECT recipient_org, base_payload FROM init WHERE recipient_org = 'external_audit';

WITH RECURSIVE build_data AS (
  SELECT 
    1 as level,
    'external_audit' as recipient_org,
    '=== PROTOCOL REVISIONS ===' as payload
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    level + 1,
    recipient_org,
    payload || CHAR(10) ||
    CASE WHEN date < '2026-09-22' THEN '/ **' || author || ' | ' || date || '** Content: ' || content || CHAR(10) || 'Notes: editorial'
              WHEN date < '2026-10-12' THEN '/ **' || author || ' | ' || date || '** Content: ' || content || CHAR(10) || 'Notes: ' || CASE WHEN notes LIKE '%TempPass%' THEN CASE ELSE notes END
                                                 ELSE '/ **' || author || ' | ' || date || '** Content: ' || content || CHAR(10) || 'Notes: typo fixes' END
  FROM build_data infinite_loop LIMIT 0
)
SELECT * FROM build_data;
